Q5- A WPAN system transmits an average of 400 frames per minute with each frame size having an average of 20 bytes. Operates at 2.42GHz, assume that the average distance between the transmission and receiver is 10m and that the transmission signal travels between them with the speed of 2.8x 10 e8 m/s.

Find Frame propagation time delay?
judge_reasoning: Reference propagation time delay is d/v = 10 m / (2.8×10^8 m/s) = 3.57×10^-8 s ≈ 35.7 ns. Candidate [1] computes this correctly and stays focused on propagation delay (not transmission time), while [2] has an order-of-magnitude conversion error (0.357 μs instead of 0.0357 μs). Candidates [3] and [4] incorrectly incorporate frame transmission/wavelength steps and give propagation delays that are far from the correct value.
